definitions.gloss: model sentence; sample text; example wording
definitions.explanation: An example sentence or sample passage provided as a model to follow, such as templates for letters, emails, or formal greetings.

examples.japanese: {文例|ぶんれい}を{参考|さんこう}にする。
examples.english: to use a model sentence for reference

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}の{文例|ぶんれい}がたくさん{載|の}っている。
examples.english: It contains many model sentences for letters.

examples.japanese: メールの{書|か}き{方|かた}に{迷|まよ}ったら{文例|ぶんれい}{集|しゅう}を{開|ひら}いてみる。
examples.english: When I'm unsure how to word an email, I open a collection of model sentences.

notes:
A ready-made example sentence offered as a model, especially for correspondence and formal writing. Built from {文|ぶん} (sentence) and {例|れい} (example).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文例|ぶんれい}{集|しゅう}: a collection of model sentences
- {文例|ぶんれい}を{参考|さんこう}にする: to refer to a model sentence
- あいさつの{文例|ぶんれい}: a model greeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {例文|れいぶん}: example sentence — illustrates usage of a word or grammar point, not a template to copy
- {定型文|ていけいぶん}: fixed/boilerplate text — a set, reusable wording
